title: Establish aspired tone matrix and miniature elevation presets for buttons and sparklines
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Several components (primary/secondary buttons, condensed tables, and tiny chart sparklines) exhibit inconsistent visual weight across light/dark themes and high-contrast modes. Current token set has coarse elevation steps and saturated accent ramps that cause borderline accessibility failures at small sizes.

Goal: Define a compact "mini" elevation and tone matrix that: (1) preserves perceived depth at micro-sizes (buttons, chips, sparklines), (2) reduces chroma for accent tokens when used at small scales to avoid color bleed, (3) introduces proportional radius/spacing scale tied to density tokens, and (4) provides clear fallback tokens for high-contrast and legacy themes. Deliverables: token JSON spec, migration map (old->new tokens), Figma component updates, and a small engineering rollout plan with feature flags for gradual adoption.
acceptance_criteria: Design token JSON defines: mini-elevation (4 steps), mini-radius scale (3 steps), mini-accent ramp (4 stops) for light/dark/high-contrast
Updated button components in Figma with visual QA for 3 sizes (xs, sm, md) in both themes
Contrast audit shows >4.5:1 for button text and actionable chart stroke in all supported sizes and themes
Migration guide and codemods with mappings for deprecated tokens ready and reviewed by engineering
Rollout experiment plan and canary flag created; feature-flagged in console for per-customer opt-in
rollout_plan: Week 1: Publish token spec and Figma components; collect feedback from PM/Accessibility/Platform
Week 2: Implement tokens in tokens repo; create codemod to map deprecated token names
Week 3: Engineering implements feature flag and builds canary route for internal apps
Week 4: Run visual regression and accessibility tests; iterate on contrast and elevation values
Week 5: Gradual enablement by customer cohort and monitor error/visual regressions; ship release notes
engineering_tasks: Add mini_* token namespace to tokens repo (mini-elevation-*, mini-radius-*, mini-accent-*)
Expose token variants in the theme loader with fallback precedence: user-theme -> mini -> base
Create codemod script: tokens/codemods/replace-mini-rollout.js and test against monorepo
Integrate visual regression snapshots for button states and sparkline strokes at 16px and 24px
Add automated contrast tests to CI for all token permutations in light/dark/high-contrast
